name: app-dark-villa-booking-flow-screen-sheet
title: Villa Booking Flow Screen Sheet
whatItIs: Eight dark phone screens: villa detail, room choices, date picker, personal information, payment, booking confirmation, bookings list and profile, with periwinkle-blue gradient buttons and step trackers.
whatItMeans: A consistent dark card system with one accent makes a long flow feel cohesive and premium.
techniques: Three-step progress tracker at the top of the flow
Big photo header on the detail screen with an overlaid info card
Range selection highlighted in blue on a calendar
Payment method icons in rounded tiles
Confirmation screen with a 3D icon as a reward moment

vocabulary.definition: A row of dots and labels showing progress through a flow.
A celebratory visual at the end of a task.
A calendar selecting start and end dates.
